citations.narrative:
A litter of three puppies transported out of the kennel on 6/29/26 were not inspected by a licensed veterinarian within 10
days of leaving the facility. Selling/shipping prior to having a completed health inspection done by a licensed veterinarian
doesn't ensure the dogs being shipped are in good health. All dogs being shipped must have a completed health
inspection done by a licensed veterinarian no more than 10 days prior to the delivery of the dogs. Correct starting on
8/18/26.

citations.desc: Cleaning, sanitization, housekeeping, and pest control.
citations.narrative:
Multiple enclosures had an excessive amount of fecal material in the outdoor parts of the enclosures. When asked the
licensee stated they were last cleaned out on Saturday (three days prior). Not removing excreta waste from the
enclosures on a daily basis can contribute to the spread of disease. All enclosures must have fecal material removed from
the enclosures on a daily basis. Correct starting on 8/18/26.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
End of report.
